title: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Contact-Rich Assembly via Proprioception-Anchored Cross-Modal Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2609.07534v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contact-rich assembly remains challenging because it requires submillimeter spatial accuracy and reliable interpretation of forces during sustained contact. Although simulation-based reinforcement learning offers a scalable training paradigm, discrepancies in visual observations, contact dynamics, and force/torque (F/T) measurements often limit policy transfer. We observe that proprioception is comparatively consistent across domains because calibrated joint positions and consistently computed joint velocities align closely between simulation and hardware. Based on this observation, we present PACE (Proprioception-Anchored Cross-Modal Encoder), which supervises temporal visual and F/T representations by predicting proprioceptive state transitions. translated_title: 基于本体感觉锚定跨模态预训练的零样本仿真到真实接触密集装配
translated_abstract: 接触密集型装配仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要亚毫米级的空间精度以及在持续接触过程中对力的可靠解读。尽管基于仿真的强化学习提供了一种可扩展的训练范式，但视觉观测、接触动力学以及力/力矩（F/T）测量中的差异通常限制了策略的迁移。我们观察到，本体感觉在跨域之间相对一致，因为经过校准的关节位置和一致计算的关节速度在仿真与真实硬件之间高度吻合。基于这一观察，我们提出了PACE（本体感觉锚定跨模态编码器），它通过预测本体感觉的状态转换来监督时序的视觉和力/力矩表征。静态的域特定因素，包括光照、纹理和传感器偏差，几乎不包含关于关节运动的信息；因此，所提出的目标函数鼓励编码器抑制（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PACE方法，利用仿真与真实之间高度一致的本体感觉作为锚点，通过预测本体感觉状态转换来监督视觉和力/力矩表征学习，从而实现接触密集型装配任务的零样本仿真到真实策略迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PACE, a cross-modal pretraining approach that leverages proprioception—consistent across simulation and hardware—as an anchor to supervise visual and force/torque representations, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real policy transfer for contact-rich assembly.
